nodes.name: CoFe-PBA nanosheet arrays synthesis
nodes.procedure: Co-Fe bimetallic Prussian blue analogue (CoFe-PBA) nanosheet arrays fabricated through a coprecipitation reaction of Co(NO3)2·6H2O and Na2[Fe(CN)5NO]·2H2O at room temperature. Co2+ coordinates with [Fe(CN)5NO]2- to form Co[Fe(CN)5(NO)]·4H2O and then in situ nucleates and grows on the surface of nickel foam (NF).

unit_operations.name: Coordination reaction
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: Co2+ coordinates with [Fe(CN)5NO]2- to form Co[Fe(CN)5(NO)]·4H2O

unit_operations.name: In situ nucleation/growth
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: in situ nucleates and grows on the surface of nickel foam (NF)

nodes.source_text: Wu and co-workers proposed an effective and easy-to-operate method to successfully fabricate Co-Fe bimetallic Prussian blue analogue (CoFe-PBA) nanosheet arrays through a coprecipitation reaction of Co(NO3)2·6H2O and Na2[Fe(CN)5NO]·2H2O (Figure 2a)

nodes.name: Ce-NiBDC/OG hydrothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: Highly oriented cerium-doped Ni-MOF nanosheets (Ce-NiBDC), which uniformly grew on the surface of conductive oxygen-functionalized graphite foil (OG, BDC = 1,4-dicarboxybenzene acid). The Ce-NiBDC nanosheets have a thickness of ~12 nm and incorporation of 2.09 wt% Ce.
nodes.source_text: Cheng et al. used a simple hydrothermal method to fabricate highly oriented cerium-doped Ni-MOF nanosheets, which uniformly grew on the surface of conductive oxygen-functionalized graphite foil (Ce-NiBDC/OG, BDC = 1,4-dicarboxybenzene acid)

nodes.name: VFe-MOF array synthesis
nodes.procedure: Bimetal VFe-MOF with well-defined array structures prepared on NF by facile ultrasonic and solvothermal methods. As a prestep, the deposition of seeds by the ultrasonic treatment could facilitate the uniform nucleation and growth of nanoarrays on NF.
nodes.source_text: Jia and co-workers prepared bimetal VFe-MOF with well-defined array structures on NF by facile ultrasonic and solvothermal methods

nodes.name: CoFe(dobpdc) nanorod solvothermal synthesis
nodes.procedure: 1D CoFe(dobpdc) (dobpdc = 4,4'-dihydroxybiphenyl-3,3'-dicarboxylate) nanorods on NF through a solvothermal process with different solvent combinations (DMF/MeOH/THF). The corresponding scanning electron microscope (SEM) images revealed different morphologies: CoFe(dobpdc)-I (rambling nanorods), CoFe(dobpdc)-II (rods at inclination angles), CoFe(dobpdc)-III (well-aligned perpendicular nanorods).

unit_operations.name: Solvent-controlled solvothermal growth
unit_operations.procedure_snippet: solvothermal process with different solvent combinations (DMF/MeOH/THF)

nodes.source_text: Xu et al. developed a facile and low-cost approach to tune the alignment orientation of 1D CoFe(dobpdc) nanorods on NF through a solvothermal process with different solvent combinations

nodes.name: BMNS self-sacrificial template synthesis
nodes.procedure: Ultrathin bimetal-MOF nanosheet arrays (BMNSs) synthesized on diverse conductive substrates by in situ transformation of metal layered double hydroxide (M-LDH) nanosheet arrays. M-LDH nanosheet arrays work as self-templates to create ultrathin array structures and as self-sacrificing precursors to dissolve metal ions with the help of solvents and ligands to supply a metal source for the growth of BMNSs.
nodes.source_text: Wang et al. successfully synthesized ultrathin bimetal-MOF nanosheet arrays (BMNSs) on diverse conductive substrates by in situ transformation of metal layered double hydroxide (M-LDH) nanosheet arrays
